prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE single rooted green loose-leaf lettuce (Lactuca sativa) plant reference for a Jiangnan miniature farm, intended for image-to-3D. Image 1 is ONLY the approved Chinese gongbi light-colour style, not bok choy anatomy. Image 2 supplies real lettuce anatomy. Soft matte thin leaf blades, selective fine moss-green contour and branching vein lines, restrained watercolor pigment mottling, fresh muted light jade greens without yellow vintage filter. Clear dimensional overlaps and shallow natural wrinkles; never inflated rubber pads or thick white bok choy stalks. Elevated three-quarter view 35 degrees down, leaves radiate into foreground, sides AND back from one basal crown; full silhouette fits with margin. Plain neutral light-gray background and neutral diffuse illumination, no cast shadow, no text, no pot, no soil or ground disk, no roots visible, no extraneous objects. End at short basal stem soil anchor. Harvest-ready mature GREEN loose-leaf lettuce. Use ONLY the green lettuce leaves in image 2; omit all red/brown varieties and fences. Broad low rounded open rosette of about 12 overlapping light-green tender leaves with softly ruffled scalloped edges and shallow puckering, larger outer leaves spreading laterally and forward, smaller inner leaves curling upright in a soft open heart. Three-dimensional hemispherical fullness, not tight iceberg ball, not romaine cylinder, no bolting stem. Every leaf attaches to a single short basal crown; lower leaf margins remain above the basal anchor. Leaf ruffles organized and readable rather than dense noisy frills; clear hand-painted fine vein contours survive 3D texturing. Retain gentle simplified silhouette consistent with image 1 style, but unmistakable loose-leaf lettuce anatomy.
revision_prompt: Edit the mature green loose-leaf lettuce reference. Preserve exact gongbi pigment mottling, fine contour style, green palette, soft ruffled thin leaves and single rooted plant. Fix only architecture and view: rotate camera to a clearly elevated 45-degree downward three-quarter view, show a truly radial bowl-shaped rosette with 3 large foreground leaves foreshortened toward the camera, 3 side leaves, 3 back leaves partly occluded, and smaller open heart leaves. Visible top surfaces and overlapping near/far leaves must establish depth comparable to width, not a frontal flat fan. Short green basal crown tucked directly under leaves, NO long thick ivory bok choy stalk bundle. Leaf bases green like lettuce. Entire plant and short soil anchor visible, no root or soil, plain neutral light gray background, even neutral light. Keep broad leaves with soft modest ruffles, not dense curly kale.
review: Revised short green crown and near/far overlapping ruffled leaves; inspect side depth in model.
